description: Uploads a bookings or clients spreadsheet (CSV text) and queues its import, as Upload on the Imports page does; nothing is written to customers until its columns are checked. source is the import source spelling, not a free label: a booking platform's key for its bookings export (for example bookingkoala), that key plus -clients for its clients export (for example bookingkoala-clients), or spreadsheet / spreadsheet-clients for a generic spreadsheet export. read('data_sources') names this business's platform. Returns jobId. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: upload_spreadsheet
title: Upload a spreadsheet to import
